original_question: Chad tụrụ ahịa burrito rụọ-ya-na-onwe-gị maka nri ehihie. Ntọala burrito bụ $6.50. Ọ na-agbakwụnye anụ maka $2.00, chiizi ọzọ maka $1.00, ube oyibo maka $1.00 na sọsụ abụọ maka $0.25 nke ọ bụla. O kpebiri ịkwalite nri ya maka $3.00 ọzọ nke ga-agbakwụnye chiipsi na otu mmanya. O nwere kaadi onyinye maka $5.00 nke ọ na-eji eme ihe ebe a na akwụ ụgwọ. Ego ole ka ọ ka ji n'ụgwọ?
